name: Tool — get_position_requirements
description: Sub-workflow called by the MCP tool get_position_requirements (workflow cvScannerMcpServer). Fixed read-only SQL as role mcp_readonly.

nodes.name: When called by the MCP tool

parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'position_id', p.id,
  'title', p.title,
  'description', p.description,
  'category', c.name,
  'level', json_build_object('code', l.code, 'name', l.name),
  'min_years_experience', p.min_years_experience,
  'criteria', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', pc.id, 'name', pc.name, 'type', pc.type, 'description', pc.description,
      'weight', pc.weight, 'is_required', pc.is_required
    ) ORDER BY pc.sort_order, pc.created_at)
    FROM position_criteria pc WHERE pc.position_id = p.id
  ), '[]'::json),
  'levels', (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('code', jl.code, 'name', jl.name) ORDER BY jl.sort_order), '[]'::json)
    FROM job_levels jl WHERE jl.is_active
  )
) AS result
FROM positions p
JOIN job_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN job_levels l ON l.id = p.level_id
WHERE p.id = $1::uuid
